title: Sparkly snow globe
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="globe" cx="40%" cy="35%" r="65%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#bfe8ff" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#7fc8f0" stop-opacity="0.55"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3a7fbf" stop-opacity="0.45"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="base" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffcf6b"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#e8a53d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b8762a"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkles around globe -->
  <g fill="#ffe98a">
    <path d="M18 30 l2.5 5 5 2.5 -5 2.5 -2.5 5 -2.5 -5 -5 -2.5 5 -2.5 z"/>
    <path d="M82 28 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 z"/>
    <path d="M86 62 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 z"/>
    <path d="M14 62 l2 3.5 3.5 2 -3.5 2 -2 3.5 -2 -3.5 -3.5 -2 3.5 -2 z"/>
    <path d="M50 12 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 z"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#fff3c0">
    <circle cx="26" cy="20" r="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="74" cy="18" r="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="88" cy="45" r="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="10" cy="44" r="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="72" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- globe base -->
  <path d="M30 78 h40 l4 8 h-48 z" fill="url(#base)"/>
  <rect x="26" y="86" width="48" height="6" rx="2.5" fill="#c98732"/>
  <rect x="26" y="86" width="48" height="2.2" rx="1" fill="#ffd98a"/>

  <!-- globe glass -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="30" fill="url(#globe)" stroke="#a8dcf7" stroke-width="1.6"/>

  <!-- snow inside -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="32" r="1.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="36" r="1.4" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="24" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="60" r="1.6" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="58" r="1.4" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="68" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="46" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- snow mound -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="22" ry="8" fill="#eaf6ff"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="22" ry="7" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- little house -->
  <rect x="42" y="47" width="16" height="13" rx="1" fill="#ff8f6b"/>
  <rect x="42" y="47" width="16" height="3" fill="#ffb08f"/>
  <path d="M39.5 47 L50 37 L60.5 47 Z" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <path d="M39.5 47 L50 37 L60.5 47 Z" fill="none" stroke="#fff0b8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="47" y="53" width="5" height="7" rx="0.8" fill="#7a4a2b"/>
  <rect x="44" y="50" width="3" height="3" fill="#ffe98a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="37" r="1" fill="#ffd166"/>

  <!-- snow on roof -->
  <path d="M39 46.5 q3 -3 6 -1 q3 -2 5 1 q3 -3 6 -1 q3 -2 5 1.5 l0 1.5 h-22 z" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- shiny highlight on glass -->
  <path d="M34 30 q6 -8 16 -6" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
